Room to spread out in the city

This is an entire apartment for your group. The kitchen and dining area sit at the centre, the bedrooms look out through full-height glass, and the balcony is there for a morning coffee above the streets.

Fresh towels are provided, and you check yourself in with a key safe.

  • Bedroom 1
    Queen bed, built-in wardrobe, floor-to-ceiling windows
  • Bedroom 2
    Two single beds, with a floor mattress available
  • Living room
    Sofa beds for extra guests, TV and a dining table
  • Two bathrooms
    Each with a shower

A building with its own pool, gym and sauna

Guests can use the building’s indoor pool, gym and sauna during their stay.

What’s included

In the apartment

  • Full kitchen: oven, cooktop, dishwasher, microwave, kettle and toaster
  • Washer and dryer in one
  • Ducted heating and cooling
  • Free, unlimited high-speed Wi-Fi
  • Flat-screen TV and a dedicated workspace
  • Portable cots on request (bring your own linen)

In the building

  • 25 m indoor heated swimming pool
  • Gym
  • Sauna

Good to know

  • Parking in the building’s car park costs $40 extra per night.
  • Check-in is around 2 pm and check-out is before 10 am. Ask us if you need different times.
  • Bed linen isn’t changed and the apartment isn’t cleaned during your stay unless you arrange it when you book. Extra charges may apply.

Close to the places you came for

The apartment is in Melbourne CBD, near Southern Cross Station. A Coles supermarket is close by, and so are car hire offices.
